name: diligent-engine
description: Diligent Engine: a modern cross-platform low-level 3D graphics library.

Provides a thin abstraction layer over Direct3D11, Direct3D12, OpenGL/GLES and Vulkan, with a common HLSL-based shader pipeline. This port builds the DiligentCore, DiligentTools and DiligentFX modules as static libraries; the samples and tutorials are not built, and the Metal and WebGPU backends are unavailable.

fx.description: Build the DiligentFX high-level rendering module (requires tools)

tools.description: Build the DiligentTools module (texture loader, GLTF loader, imgui integration)

vulkan.description: Vulkan backend, dispatched through the volk loader
